snippet.title: Snatch – A Modern Take on Crash Bash-Inspired Gameplay]
snippet.description:
"Snatch" is a modern spin on the classic "Crash Bash," featuring enhanced visuals and innovative gameplay. 

As Lead Developer, I directed a team of five to deliver this cross-platform game for Android, iOS, and PC. 

My contributions include:

-Game Design
-Programming mechanics
-Multiplayer integration
-AI development
-UI/UX design
-Level design
-Character rigging + animations. 
-Project management using Scrum (Jira)
-Asset optimization
-Game optimization
-Clean, efficient code.

Duration: 8 months
